basic_information.title: Decentralized Peer-to-Peer Micro-Lending and Escrow Platform
basic_information.summary: A financial technology platform connecting individual borrowers with lenders directly, utilizing smart contracts for escrow services and automated repayment enforcement.

abstract: Traditional micro-lending often involves high intermediary fees and strict geographic limitations. This project presents a decentralized Peer-to-Peer (P2P) lending platform designed to eliminate middlemen. The platform matches lenders seeking yield with borrowers needing small-scale loans. By leveraging blockchain-based smart contracts, the system creates transparent escrow accounts that hold collateral and automate the disbursement and repayment processes. To mitigate default risk, the platform incorporates a basic credit scoring algorithm based on past transaction history on the network. The solution demonstrates the viability of decentralized finance (DeFi) principles for inclusive micro-lending.
problem_statement: Unbanked or underbanked individuals face significant hurdles in accessing small loans due to lack of traditional credit histories, while potential retail lenders lack secure platforms to offer micro-loans directly to peers.

primary: Design a decentralized platform for requesting and funding micro-loans.
Implement smart contracts to handle escrow, fund disbursement, and automated repayments.
Develop a reputation-based credit scoring system.
secondary: Ensure an intuitive user interface that abstracts blockchain complexity for average users.

included: Loan request creation and marketplace browsing.
Smart contract escrow for collateral and loan principal.
Reputation scoring based on repayment history.
excluded: Legal debt collection procedures for defaults.
scope.deployment_context: Web application interacting with smart contracts deployed on a layer-2 blockchain testnet (e.g., Polygon Mumbai).

features.name: Loan Marketplace
features.description: Lenders can browse open loan requests, filtering by interest rate, duration, and borrower reputation.

features.name: Smart Contract Escrow
features.description: Secures collateral and automates the release of funds based on predefined loan terms.

features.name: Reputation Dashboard
features.description: Displays a user's borrowing history and calculated credit score.

modules.name: Smart Contract Module
modules.purpose: Executes trustless financial agreements between peers.
responsibilities: Transfer loan principal to the borrower.
Handle repayments and liquidate collateral upon default.

modules.name: Scoring and Analytics Module
modules.purpose: Calculates trust scores based on network activity.
responsibilities: Index blockchain events related to repayments.
Apply the scoring algorithm to determine reputation.

frameworks.name: Ethers.js
frameworks.purpose: Library for interacting with the Ethereum blockchain.

database.name: The Graph
database.purpose: Decentralized protocol for indexing and querying blockchain data.

platforms.name: Polygon Testnet
platforms.purpose: Target blockchain for low-cost, fast transactions.

ai_usage.description: Credit scoring is currently rule-based and does not utilize machine learning models.

algorithms.name: Reputation Scoring Algorithm
algorithms.purpose: Calculates a score based on successful repayments, loan sizes, and defaults.

reasons: Requires careful smart contract design to prevent financial exploits.
Complexity in handling edge cases like partial repayments and liquidations.

phase_breakdown.phase: Smart contract design and security auditing

expected_outcomes: A fully functional set of lending smart contracts deployed on a testnet.
A web interface allowing users to create and fund loans.
A working demonstration of the automated collateral liquidation process.
limitations: Over-collateralization is required, which may exclude the poorest borrowers.
Susceptible to extreme cryptocurrency price volatility.
Regulatory uncertainty regarding peer-to-peer crypto lending.
future_scope: Implement under-collateralized loans utilizing decentralized identity (DID) solutions.
Integrate machine learning for advanced risk assessment and credit scoring.
Establish liquidity pools to automate the matching of lenders and borrowers.
